before.prompt: Querying jsonb_path_ops vs jsonb_ops GIN indexes differ mainly in:

options.option_text: jsonb_path_ops indexes only @> containment queries — smaller and faster for that use
jsonb_path_ops supports all operators including key-exists

before.explanation: jsonb_path_ops produces a smaller index supporting only @> and jsonpath; jsonb_ops also supports ?, ?|, ?& key-exists operators.

after.explanation: jsonb_path_ops produces a smaller index and supports @>, @?, @@; unlike jsonb_ops, it does not support the ?, ?|, and ?& key-existence operators.

option_texts.C: jsonb_path_ops supports @>, @?, and @@ but not key-existence operators; its index is smaller and often faster for supported queries
